Haut-Uele: 45 patients for 169 beds (26.6%), weak network, staff demotivation, nutrition, water and electricity gaps; Tshopo: 16 patients for 36 beds (44.4%), lacking resuscitation equipment and PEP staff, and the 54th confirmed case remains lost to follow-up.
Tshopo: two confirmed patients from Bafwasende escaped. Bas-Uele: 11 suspects in isolation while 18 verified sick people are not isolated and remain in the community.

Bas-Uele Ervebo stock out (0 doses) with coverage 11.4% (1500/13202); Ituri reaches 1007 vaccinated frontline workers against a provisional target of 1000 that remains to be redefined. Vaccine logistics do not establish efficacy against Bundibugyo.

Bas-Uele lists 11 suspects only (SR151: 3 confirmed and 11 suspects) while follow-up of the isolated confirmed child at Dingila continues. Not repaired.

Two bodies repatriated from Burundi were intercepted at Kavimvira (Sud-Kivu) and validated without swab; one body came from Arua (Uganda) into Ariwara. No case is inferred from either.
